protocol: 3 repeats; 100 warmup + 500 measured 33ms-timestamp frames; first N fixed .022-scale hands for IDs; legacy fixtures separately; palm uses existing absolute defaults and pointing swipes. Render-policy replay: 20 warmup + 200 measured frames, synthetic 1080p BGR, 3 repeats, no HighGUI. All raw reports retained locally under hand_tracking/benchmarks. New controller benchmark supplies capture age.
aggregation: Mean of equal-sized run means; median of per-run P95, not pooled P95. Timings vary with load; process not CPU-isolated. Baseline legacy first repeat overlapped a cProfile diagnostic; inspect all repeats.

instrumentation_microbenchmark.protocol: 3 x 20000 iterations, 12 timing adds, workload/state finish and one cursor notification per iteration; no pipeline, camera or input. Includes loop/clock arithmetic overhead.

native_window_lifecycle_smoke.note: Generated 320x180 BGR window; ShowWindow minimize/restore and owned WM_CLOSE. Lifecycle check only, no throughput or webcam measurement.
